title: Indole-3-carbinol inhibits PD-L1-mediated immune evasion in hepatocellular carcinoma via suppressing NF-kappaB p105 Ubiquitination.
authors: Wu, Yongkang; Tao, Qing; Xie, Jing; Liu, Xiao; Zhou, Yuanzhi; Wei, Chengyan; Zhang, Chunwei; Wang, Jingjing; Jin, Yong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吲哚-3-甲醇通过抑制NF-kappaB p105泛素化下调PD-L1的免疫逃逸机制，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the most common malignant tumors worldwide, and immunotherapy has demonstrated significant therapeutic benefit in HCC. Indole-3-carbinol (I3C), a naturally occurring ingredient of cruciferous vegetables, significantly inhibits the growth of a wide range of tumors. However, its mechanism of action has not been fully elucidated. PURPOSE: This study aims to verify and explore the immunomodulatory effect of I3C in HCC models, and to investigate the specific role and mechanism by which I3C affects PD-L1 expression through the ubiquitination of NF-kappaB p105. METHODS: In vitro, I3C was treated with HepG2 cells and relevant indicators were analyzed. In vivo, the mouse HCC model was established and the effect of I3C on tumors and immune function was evaluated. Subsequently, the downstream target of I3C was found through target prediction, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation. Finally, combined therapy was used to further investigate the effect of I3C on mouse HCC tumors. RESULTS: We observed that I3C resulted in decreased programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression in HepG2 cells and increased CD8 T cell infiltration in tissues. Subsequently, target prediction and molecular docking demonstrated that I3C was able to efficiently bind to NF-kappaB p105. In addition, overexpression of NF-kappaB p105 upregulated PD-L1 expression and almost completely eliminated the inhibitory effect of I3C. Notably, the combination of I3C and PD-L1 monoclonal antibodies showed synergistic anti-tumor effects in the mouse HCC model. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrated that I3C inhibits PD-L1-mediated immune evasion in HCC via suppressing NF-kappaB p105 ubiquitination. The role of I3C in tumors deserves further investigation and provides the foundation for the future development of novel immunotherapeutic drugs.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（HCC）是全球最常见的恶性肿瘤之一，免疫治疗在HCC中已显示出显著的治疗效果。吲哚-3-甲醇（I3C）是十字花科蔬菜中的一种天然成分，能显著抑制多种肿瘤的生长。然而，其作用机制尚未完全阐明。目的：本研究旨在验证并探讨I3C在HCC模型中的免疫调节作用，并研究I3C通过NF-kappaB p105泛素化影响PD-L1表达的具体作用及机制。方法：体外实验中，用I3C处理HepG2细胞并分析相关指标。体内实验中，建立小鼠HCC模型，评估I3C对肿瘤及免疫功能的影响。随后，通过靶点预测、分子对接和分子动力学模拟找到I3C的下游靶点。最后，采用联合治疗进一步研究I3C对小鼠HCC肿瘤的作用。结果：我们观察到I3C导致HepG2细胞中程序性细胞死亡配体1（PD-L1）表达降低，并增加组织中CD8 T细胞浸润。随后，靶点预测和分子对接表明I3C能有效结合NF-kappaB p105。此外，NF-kappaB p105的过表达上调了PD-L1表达，并几乎完全消除了I3C的抑制作用。值得注意的是，I3C与PD-L1单克隆抗体的联合使用在小鼠HCC模型中显示出协同抗肿瘤效应。结论：本研究证明I3C通过抑制NF-kappaB p105泛素化来抑制HCC中PD-L1介导的免疫逃逸。I3C在肿瘤中的作用值得进一步研究，并为未来开发新型免疫治疗药物奠定了基础。
